title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Join our applied ML team building demand-forecasting models for retail clients. You will clean and explore data with Pandas and NumPy, train models with scikit-learn and XGBoost, and ship them behind Flask or FastAPI services. Requirements: strong Python, solid grasp of machine learning fundamentals, statistics, and SQL. Nice to have: Docker, experience with time series forecasting, Git. 6-month internship, stipend provided.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Quantera builds risk analytics for fintech lenders. As a Data Science Intern you will run exploratory data analysis, build credit-scoring models with scikit-learn and LightGBM, and present findings with Matplotlib and Seaborn dashboards. You should know Python, Pandas, SQL, and statistics (hypothesis testing, A/B testing). Bonus: experience with Jupyter, Tableau or Power BI.

title: GenAI / LLM Engineering Intern
description: Help us build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) products. You'll write Python services with FastAPI, build embeddings pipelines on PostgreSQL with pgvector, experiment with LangChain and LangGraph agents, and write evals for LLM outputs. Must have: Python, REST APIs, familiarity with LLMs and prompt engineering. Nice to have: Docker, React, AWS.

title: Computer Vision Research Intern
description: Work on satellite imagery segmentation. You will train deep learning models in PyTorch, use OpenCV for preprocessing, and track experiments with Weights & Biases. Requirements: Python, deep learning, computer vision coursework or projects, linear algebra. Nice to have: CUDA, C++, published research.

title: NLP Intern
description: Extract structured data from clinical notes. You'll fine-tune transformer models with Hugging Face, build text classification baselines with scikit-learn, and use spaCy for entity recognition. Required: Python, NLP fundamentals, machine learning. Preferred: PyTorch, SQL, experience writing model evaluation reports.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Support the growth team with weekly reporting. You will write SQL queries against BigQuery, build dashboards in Tableau, and analyze A/B tests. Requirements: SQL, Excel, data visualization, statistics. Python with Pandas is a plus.

title: Robotics Software Intern
description: Write real-time control software for warehouse robots in C++ on Linux. Experience with ROS, embedded systems, and computer vision with OpenCV is required. Python for tooling is a plus.

title: iOS Developer Intern
description: Build features for our consumer iOS app in Swift and SwiftUI. Requirements: Swift, Xcode, REST APIs, Git. Experience publishing an app to the App Store is a plus.

title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern - Forecasting
description: Build time series forecasting models for power demand. You'll use Python, Pandas, scikit-learn and LightGBM, orchestrate pipelines with Airflow, and deploy models with Docker on AWS. Must have: Python, machine learning, SQL, Git. Nice to have: MLflow, Kubernetes.

title: Marketing Intern
description: Plan social media campaigns, write copy, and coordinate with influencers. Strong communication skills, Canva, and Excel required.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description: 6+ years of experience leading data science teams. Deep expertise in causal inference, Spark, and production ML on GCP. This is not an internship role.

title: AI Product Intern
description: Prototype AI tutoring features. You'll build small Flask or FastAPI backends, call LLM APIs, design prompts, and measure quality with simple evals. Requirements: Python, REST APIs, curiosity about LLMs. Nice to have: React or Next.js, SQL, user research experience.

title: Quantitative Analytics Intern
description: Model portfolio risk using statistics and time series methods. Requirements: Python or R, NumPy, SciPy, statistics, probability. Experience with SQL and Excel is a plus. Finance coursework preferred.

title: MLOps Intern
description: Help build our model serving platform. You'll containerize models with Docker, deploy to Kubernetes, write CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, and monitor models with MLflow. Requirements: Python, Linux, Docker, Git. Nice to have: Terraform, AWS, FastAPI.

title: Data Science Intern - Crop Yield
description: Predict crop yields from weather and satellite data. Use Python, Pandas, scikit-learn and XGBoost; run feature engineering and model evaluation; present results in Jupyter notebooks. Requirements: machine learning, statistics, Python. Nice to have: PostgreSQL, Flask.

title: Game Developer Intern
description: Build gameplay systems in Unity using C#. Requirements: C#, Unity, OOP, data structures. Experience with shaders or Blender is a plus.

title: Bioinformatics ML Intern
description: Apply deep learning to protein sequence data. Requirements: Python, PyTorch, machine learning, biology coursework. Nice to have: JAX, Linux, experience with HPC clusters.

title: Search & Recommendations Intern
description: Improve our recommender systems. You'll build embeddings-based retrieval with vector databases, train ranking models with scikit-learn and LightGBM, and evaluate offline with Python and SQL. Required: Python, machine learning, SQL. Preferred: Elasticsearch, Docker, FastAPI.

title: Backend Engineering Intern
description: Build payment APIs in Go and Java with PostgreSQL and Kafka. Requirements: data structures and algorithms, REST APIs, SQL, Git. Docker and microservices experience is a plus.

title: Data Engineering Intern
description: Build ELT pipelines for emissions data. You'll write SQL and dbt models on Snowflake, orchestrate with Airflow, and write Python data validation. Requirements: SQL, Python, Git. Nice to have: Spark, Docker, data visualization.
